# DOCUMENTATION INSTRUCTIONS

1. Do not edit auto-generated sections of `docs/ai/*.md` files marked `<!-- AUTO-GENERATED -->`. Run `npm run ai:sync`.
2. Maintain human-authored content inside `<!-- BEGIN HUMAN --> ... <!-- END HUMAN -->` blocks.
3. Record significant architectural trade-offs in `docs/ai/DECISIONS.md` using ADR format.
4. Record bug fixes in `docs/ai/KNOWN_ISSUES.md` with reproducer steps and resolving commit SHAs.
